parsed.restated: ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ S : Set (Fin n → ℝ), Convex ℝ S ∧ IsCompact S ∧ (interior S).Nonempty ∧ barycenter S = 0 ∧ {z : Fin n → ℤ | (fun i => (z i : ℝ)) ∈ interior S} = {0} ∧ ((volume : Measure (Fin n → ℝ)) S).toReal = ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)
parsed.proof:
constructor
· intro h n hn
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := h n hn
  exact ⟨K.carrier, K.convex, K.compact, K.fullDimensional, K.centered, K.uniqueInteriorLatticePoint, hK⟩
· intro h n hn
  obtain ⟨S, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := h n hn
  exact ⟨⟨S, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩, h6⟩
parsed.english: For every n > 0 there is a convex compact set S in ℝⁿ with nonempty interior, barycenter 0, whose only interior integer lattice point is the origin, and whose Lebesgue volume equals (n+1)^n / n!.
parsed.why_clearer: It unfolds the CenteredBody structure and the volume, lattice-point and sharp-constant definitions into explicit conditions on a set S.
